nodes.label: MotionScore Performance Audit
nodes.rationale: The methodology must be read in full before any audit and followed exactly — do not audit from memory, because grades must be reproducible and the served copy is the only current one as it tracks the scoring engine. Static and runtime audits triangulate well.

nodes.label: MotionScore (S–F animation cost grading)
nodes.rationale: Grades every animation by render-pipeline cost, from S (compositor-only) down to F (forced synchronous layout every frame); audits follow one written procedure so a grade means the same thing wherever it is produced.
